decisions.HIQ-01: REF-COND reference installation = hall_c1_reference in every block; predecessor asymmetry preserved and reported
decisions.HIQ-02: three complete balanced replicate sets, >= 6 blocks before any larger LOCK-2 n
decisions.HIQ-03: bounded Xe reference/health check at the start of the installation, before N2 and any O2-bearing exposure
decisions.HIQ-04: HI-HOLDOUT-A frozen before the first Hall-on H-1 reading (incl. Ar); held-out enumeration after LOCK-1, before HI-S1
decisions.HIQ-05: no mandatory Pareto relation; hard gates decide feasibility; Pareto reported unless a condition is preregistered at LOCK-1
decisions.HIQ-06: primary ICP gas mode G-REUSE (Hall exhaust/residual); dedicated ICP port installed and capped; G-ATM / G-XE are declared contingency variants; score-bearing N2/N2+O2 uses G-REUSE unless it fails the preregistered ICP-capacity gate; no dedicated Xe to make the ICP work

HIQ-06_accounting.G-REUSE: mdot_ICP,dedicated = 0 (no double counting of Hall feed)
HIQ-06_accounting.G-XE: mdot_ICP,Xe booked explicitly in the Xe ledger under PHASE_TOTAL_FLOW

decisions.HIQ-07: pure-N2 hall_icp_neutralizer readings sequestered for a future Hall-transport preregistration
decisions.HIQ-08: HI-AR before LOCK-1, after HI-HOLDOUT-A; Ar never enters LOCK-2 numbers, decision quantities or DRDO compliance claims
decisions.UBQ-01: 1 % thrust target = standard relative uncertainty (k = 1), sustained reading; gates use preregistered one-sided treatment
decisions.UBQ-02: M_n = I_e,cap / I_d,dem - 1; gate on one-sided lower confidence bound > 0; any extra design margin frozen at LOCK-2 per LOCK-1 rule
decisions.UBQ-03: manufacturer +-x bound rectangular (u = a/sqrt(3)) unless the certificate states otherwise
decisions.UBQ-04: normalized agreement statistic with k_x = 2 frozen at LOCK-1; failure -> RF-dependent quantities EXCLUDED_INSTRUMENT
decisions.UBQ-05: calibration shift both in the budget and as a block-exclusion rule; rule form at LOCK-1, number at LOCK-2 from metrology-only evidence
decisions.UBQ-06: score-bearing temperature aborts at validated continuous-use limit minus 50 K
decisions.UBQ-07: family-wise alpha 0.05 for simultaneous contrasts (preregistered multiplicity control, e.g. Holm); one-sided alpha 0.05 per absolute gate; frozen at LOCK-1
decisions.UBQ-08: Ar-specific gauge/MFC/RGA calibration required for HI-AR; Ar stays engineering-only
decisions.UBQ-09: SR-C-MARGIN stopping (not sign-only); margin rule at LOCK-1, numerical value at LOCK-2

OQ-A902-01.gate_quantity: P_bus,1ms,max = max_t (1/1 ms) integral_t^{t+1 ms} P_bus dt
OQ-A902-01.requirement: P_bus,1ms,max < 1500 W, startup and steady state, unless the official RFP provides a transient exception
measurement: sample rate >= 100 kSa/s per relevant channel or equivalent direct bus-power channel
OQ-A902-01.also_record: unaveraged sampled peak (protection analysis only; not the 1.5 kW gate); 100 ms and 1 s averages as diagnostics
OQ-A902-01.status: A9 engineering definition pending authoritative RFP wording (not an ECSS requirement)

decisions.OQ-A902-02: 300 W common allocation = compressor + atm/Xe/ICP flow-control + filter/getter if active + thermal control + housekeeping/controls; 50 W controls/thermal inside it; extra active cooling and reserved ports outside unless reallocated
decisions.OQ-A902-03: no fixed Hall/ICP split; P_ICP,available = 1350 - P_common - P_Hall - P_other_active at every registered condition; ICP-45 demonstrated within it; 0-500 W lab RF is a test capability only
decisions.OQ-A902-04: no combined flight C1 + ICP installation in primary A9 (would be a new variant with its own closures)
decisions.OQ-A902-05: primary G-REUSE; flow_control_icp_feed booked only when G-ATM or G-XE is installed/used; capped port stays in the ICD
decisions.OQ-A902-06: housekeeping and thermal routed through the internal propulsion bus by default; any direct spacecraft-input path represented explicitly
decisions.OQ-A902-07: report 1300 W as context/sensitivity; active internal check 1350 W; hard requirement 1500 W
decisions.SEQ-heater: C1 procedure states heater command/power at every step; until then TBD heater = ON at conservative booked power; never PASS by assuming off
decisions.SEQ-peaks: baseline: at most one peak-class load commanded to rise per startup step; overlap = registered variant needing measured transient evidence
decisions.ICP-45: formal entry condition: ICP-45A (Ar, engineering-only) and ICP-45N (N2) demonstrate I_e,cap >= I_d,max before any score-bearing hall_icp_neutralizer point; record I_e, RF fwd/refl, DC input, collector V/I, pressure, gas state, thermal state, stability; Takahashi ~1 A/200 W context only, not scaled; I_d,max from the registered H-1/discharge-supply envelope
decisions.ICP-46: C1 keeper pulse 300-600 V: design isolation basis 900 V; development hipot 1.0 kV DC at representative pressure/gas, no breakdown, leakage recorded; separate 600 V pulse-waveform test; applies to lead, feedthrough, connectors, harness, isolation to cathode common/module body/facility ground; does not replace ICP-44; flight level may only be revised upward without controlled justification
decisions.A9-03-planes: IP-EXIT = H-1 exit; IP-NEU = downstream neutralizer datum; historical IP-DN unchanged
decisions.A9-03-Vd: primary controlled quantity V_d = V_anode - V_electron-source-reference; supply-terminal voltage and loop drops secondary
decisions.A9-03-matching: matching network off the moving stand platform (matched flexible coax, cable-loss/S-parameter correction, coupler reference plane after the matching network, matched sham routing in C1); on-platform only if S1a proves necessary
decisions.A9-03-collector: flight collector material not frozen; 316L allowed for Ar engineering reproduction; candidates go through the O/AO coupon programme before N2/O2 life claims
decisions.OQ-EV-02: acquisition order P1 LA-01..03; P2 LA-04, LA-06..08; P3 LA-05, LA-09
decisions.OQ-EV-03: YES: values may be extracted from lawfully accessed publisher-served full text with URL, DOI, locator, access date, evidence class; no redistribution of non-redistributable PDFs
